          "name": "Brooklyn AI-Native 6G Summit 2026 | Day 2 Highlights",
          "description": "How do we build, scale and monetize AI-native infrastructure?
 
Day 2 of the 2026 Brooklyn AI-Native 6G Summit shifted the conversation from vision to execution, exploring what it will take to make AI-native connectivity a reality.
Discussions spanned distributed compute and networking, AI-powered software development, AI-RAN for the 6G era, non-terrestrial networks, and the importance of trust, privacy and security as AI continues to scale.
 
Across two days, one message came through clearly: the next era of connectivity will be shaped not by AI, compute or networking in isolation, but by bringing them together.
Catch the Day 2 highlights and see how this year’s summit helped set the agenda for the journey toward AI-native networks and the broader AI Supercycle.

          "description": "What will networks need to become at the dawn of the AI Supercycle?

Catch the highlights from Day 1 of the 2026 Brooklyn AI-Native 6G Summit, hosted by Nokia and NYU WIRELESS at NYU Tandon School of Engineering in Brooklyn, New York.

Industry leaders, researchers and innovators explored how AI is reshaping connectivity and bringing compute, intelligence and networking closer together.

From lessons from the Software-Defined Networking era and the evolution toward more open AI-native infrastructure to AI-RAN, Physical AI and integrated sensing, the discussions explored both the opportunities ahead and the challenges that need to be overcome.

          "name": "A bit of tech: Episode 6 – Creating the Sixth Sense",
          "description": "Our sixth episode covers the groundbreaking sensing capabilities that are becoming central to our communication networks. Nokia Bell Labs’ Head of Optical Systems and Device Research Tod Sizer joins Aron Heller to review various elements of this digital “sixth sense” that can pick up signals from our environment and offer spectacular insights.           "@type": "VideoObject",
          "name": "Bits of imagination: Networks with a digital sixth sense",
          "description": "Can you hear it? Can you feel it? Can you sense it?  

From detecting cosmic radio waves in 1932 to pioneering radar technologies in 1941, Nokia Bell Labs has always been at the forefront of discovery. But sensing isn’t just about hearing or seeing - it’s about finding meaning in the noise around us. 

Today, we’re transforming how we sense the world with our groundbreaking sensing technology to detect earthquakes and tsunamis with incredible precision using subsea fiber-optic cables. 

And the future? It’s even more exciting. With 6G, the network itself will become a sensor—a digital sixth sense, making cities safer, factories smarter, and our perception sharper than ever before. 

Learn more about the future of sensing technologies: https://www.nokia.com/bell-labs/#sensing 

Explore more about Bell Labs' century of groundbreaking achievements and innovations: https://www.nokia.com/bell-labs/100/",

<script>
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
    const parentElement = document.querySelector('.m3_transparent');

    const mobileElement = document.querySelector('.nokia-header__menu-hamburger');
        if (mobileElement) {
        mobileElement.addEventListener('click', function() {
          const isChecked = document.getElementById('n-mega-menu').checked;
          if(isChecked){
            parentEle.classList.add('m3-header_top');
          }else{
            parentEle.classList.remove('m3-header_top');
          }
        });
    }

    if (parentElement) {
      const hoverElement =  document.querySelector('.nokia-header__mega-menu-main');
      const breadcrumb = document.querySelector('.breadcrumb');
      const mBreadcrumb = document.querySelector('.m-breadcrumb');
      const isDark = document.querySelector('.page-m3-dark');

      hoverElement && hoverElement.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() {
        parentElement.classList.add('m3-header_top');
      });

      hoverElement && hoverElement.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() {
        parentElement.classList.remove('m3-header_top');
      });

      if (breadcrumb) {
        const textArea = document.querySelector('.m-2-2-introduction-text-area');
        if (textArea) {
          textArea.classList.add('m-2-2-introduction-text-area-breadcrumbs');
        }        
        breadcrumb.classList.add(
          isDark ? 'm-2-2-breadcrumb-theme-dark' : 'm-2-2-breadcrumb-theme-light'
        );
        mBreadcrumb.classList.add(
          isDark ? 'm-2-2-breadcrumb-theme-dark' : 'm-2-2-breadcrumb-theme-light'
        );
      }
    }
    const mBreadcrumb = document.querySelector('.m-breadcrumb');
    if (mBreadcrumb) {
      const breadcrumbImages = mBreadcrumb.querySelectorAll('img');

      breadcrumbImages.forEach(img => {
        if (img.src.includes('chevron-left-small.svg')) {
          let newSrc = img.src;

          if (mBreadcrumb.classList.contains('m-2-2-breadcrumb-theme-dark')) {
            newSrc = img.src.replace('chevron-left-small.svg', 'chevron-left-small-dark.svg');
          } else if (mBreadcrumb.classList.contains('m-2-2-breadcrumb-theme-light')) {
            newSrc = img.src.replace('chevron-left-small.svg', 'chevron-left-small-light.svg');
          }
          img.src = newSrc + '?v=' + new Date().getTime();
        }
      });
    }
  });
</script>
